title: Profile
description: A user profile, keyed by the wallet address that owns it. Every property besides ss58address and x25519Key is optional; the ones marked server-assigned are set by the API and ignored when a caller sends them.

ss58address.description: The wallet address of the profile (primary key). An SS58 address, or a base58 Solana public key.

nickname.description: Optional unique nickname for the profile

profilePicture.description: URL to the profile picture. Set by the image endpoint.

userId.description: The user's id, always equal to ss58address. Server-assigned; a value that contradicts the wallet address is refused rather than corrected.

email.description: Contact email. Checked for shape, never verified by a round-trip.

address.description: Postal address, as one free-text block

background.description: Professional background — the longer form of title

roles.description: The roles the user declares. Self-assigned and freely editable by the owner; duplicates are collapsed on save.

permission.description: Per-role clearance. Admin-only to write: a non-admin write leaves the stored map untouched. An absent role has never been assessed, which is not the same as revoked.

createdAt.description: When the profile was first stored. Server-assigned; null for rows written before this field existed.

updatedAt.description: When the profile last changed. Server-assigned.
